evidence: decorative_mascot: In seg3:start/mid/end and seg4 Data just stands on top of the left bubble. On the ladders (hook@1.5, seg2:end) he points at the tallest bar. In seg1 he stands with his arms raised. He never makes the data move.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: In seg3:start/mid/end both circles read "127%" and both are labelled "Billionaire wealth". The narration says the S&P 500 grew 195%, but that number and an S&P label never appear, and the two circles grow to the same size.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The comparison machine bound the same series (billionaire wealth, 127%) to both sides. The second entity, the S&P 500 at 195%, was dropped, so the scene draws a comparison of a value with itself and contradicts the claim it is there to prove.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Bind the right side to S&P 500 = 195% with its own label, and scale the two forms to the values so the S&P side is clearly bigger. Put the ink-colored value inside a form that is large enough for it. Have Data push or pump the S&P side as it overtakes, so the payoff "most of this is just stocks" can be seen.
